title: Diversity of Matter: Materials
voice: Microsoft Zira Desktop (stand-in until the voice-over artist records)

pages.say: A material is what a thing is made of.
Look at a cup. It may be made of clay. A bag may be made of plastic.
A door may be made of wood, and a cooking pot of metal.
First, you will learn what a material is, and how it is different from the object made from it.
Next, you will look at properties. Is it hard or soft? Does it bend? Does water pass through it?
Then you will sort materials. Some come from nature, like wood and cotton. People make others, like glass and plastic.
After that, you will choose a material for a job, and say why it suits that job.
Last, you will think about caring for materials, and how to reuse them so less is wasted.
As you watch, look around you. Every thing you see is made of a material.
